_note: Spec and credit record of the north outpost ambience beds (#4460, GA-O12): a generator hum, a crackling fire, a radio murmuring in a tent and wind through the nets. Same pipeline as ambience.json (tools/assets/pipeline/ambience.mjs); run with this file swapped in for ambience.json, then the output moved to Sounds/Ambience/Outposts. Prompts never name an artist, a song or a label.

sounds.name: OutpostGenerator
sounds.prompt: Small diesel generator running steadily outdoors at a camp: a low constant engine hum with a soft rattle of the casing, no revving, no speech, no music.
sounds.reason: Take 2 has a loop step of 0.02x (take 1 0.28x would click at the seam) and the same hum level.

sounds.name: OutpostFire
sounds.prompt: A campfire burning steadily at night: soft crackling and popping of dry wood, a gentle low flame rush, an occasional settling log. No voices, no music, no wind.
sounds.reason: Take 1 runs the full 19.3 s of crackle (take 2 is cut to 16.5 s) with a seamless loop step of 0.00x.

sounds.name: OutpostRadio
sounds.prompt: A small portable radio murmuring inside a canvas tent, heard from a few steps away: a muffled talking voice in a foreign language with no clear words, thin and tinny, with a faint static hiss under it. No music.
sounds.reason: Take 2 has the lower loop step (0.10x against 0.14x) at the same band-limited level; both are an unintelligible murmur.

sounds.name: OutpostWind
sounds.prompt: Night wind moving through camouflage nets stretched over a camp: a soft airy whistle and the slow flutter and rustle of loose netting and canvas, gusts rising and fading gently. No voices, no music, no engines.
sounds.reason: Take 1 is louder and fuller (rms -19 dB against -21 dB) with the same 0.04x loop step, so the gusts carry at distance.
